news.title: Kolte-Patil Developers shares surged 15% after a robust Q4 business update.

news.title:
Kolte Patil Q4 FY26 sales at ₹714 cr, collections hit record ₹834 cr, marking 13% YoY rise in sales and 18% in collections.
FY26 sales reached ₹2,605 cr; record collections ₹2,689 cr supported by 19% 5-year CAGR. Stock closed at ₹347.05, up 2% on BSE.
news.summary:
Kolte Patil Q4 FY26 sales at ₹714 cr, collections hit record ₹834 cr, marking 13% YoY rise in sales and 18% in collections.

news.title:
Kolte-Patil Q4FY26 sales Rs 714 Cr, up 13% YoY; FY26 sales Rs 2,605 Cr.
Blackstone acquired 40% stake; FY26 project launches total 4.6M sq.ft.
news.summary:

news.title:
CRISIL reaffirmed Kolte-Patil Developers' ratings: Crisil AA (Stable) for long-term, Crisil A1 for short-term.
Total bank loan facilities rated at Rs.800 crore, including guarantees, overdrafts, and term loans.

news.title:
Kolte-Patil Developers confirms timely principal payments for its NCDs as per SEBI regulations.
Partial redemptions were executed under an amortization plan, reducing the face value and redemption premiums.

news.title:
Kolte-Patil Dec '25 net sales fell 24.1% Y-o-Y to Rs 265.3 cr; net profit dropped 82.2% to Rs 4.5 cr.
EBITDA declined 45.7% to Rs 24.5 cr; EPS decreased to Rs 0.51 from Rs 3.33. Shares gained 36.5% over 12 months.
news.summary:
Kolte-Patil Dec '25 net sales fell 24.1% Y-o-Y to Rs 265.3 cr; net profit dropped 82.2% to Rs 4.5 cr.
EBITDA declined 45.7% to Rs 24.5 cr; EPS decreased to Rs 0.51 from Rs 3.33. Shares gained 36.5% over 12 months.
